headline: Sensex Rallies 427 Points as Banking Stocks and Foreign Inflows Drive Markets Higher

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong foreign fund inflows fueled the November surge in Indian benchmark indices.
Banking stocks powered gains, driving Nifty Bank to a record high.
Moderate crude oil prices helped sustain buying momentum across sectors.
Indices opened higher and gained intraday momentum despite mixed global cues.
whatHappening: Sensex ended 427 points higher while Nifty50 closed at 25,387.
BlackRock increased its shareholding stake in Axis Bank to 5%.
Signature Global-led consortium acquired 194 acres of land via auction for Rs 194 crore.
Wipro 3D partnered with Markforged to expand industrial 3D printing solutions across India.
summary: Indian equities rallied as Sensex surged 427 points and Nifty50 closed at 25,387, driven by strong gains in banking stocks and foreign institutional inflows. Key corporate developments included BlackRock raising its stake in Axis Bank to 5% and Signature Global securing a major land parcel. Wipro 3D also announced a strategic tie-up with Markforged to expand 3D printing in India.
